idea-plugin.name: Pi Launcher
idea-plugin.description:
Pi Launcher

One-click Pi coding agent launcher for JetBrains IDEs — keeps the Pi CLI one click away inside the IDE.

Important: Install the Pi CLI separately before using this plugin.
npm i -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent or visit pi.dev

Features

  • One-click launch from the toolbar
  • Integrated terminal that opens a dedicated "Pi" tab inside the Terminal tool window
  • Send to Pi — select code, right-click, and send file reference (@path/file.go#L10-25) to Pi's input
  • Status bar state that follows Pi when it stops
  • Silent — no diff tabs, no completion balloons, no exit reports
  • Optional auto-open of modified files (off by default)
  • Flexible configuration for models, thinking levels, and launch options

Usage

Quick Start

  1. Click the pi button in the main toolbar.
  2. A new "Pi" tab opens in the Terminal window and runs pi automatically.
  3. Select code, right-click, then Send to Pi to add file context to your prompt.

Configuration

Open Settings, Tools, Pi Launcher to pick the model, thinking level and launch options.

Keyboard Shortcuts

  • Ctrl+Shift+Backquote — Launch or focus Pi
  • Ctrl+Shift+L — Send selection to Pi

Supported IDEs

Works with all JetBrains IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, CLion, Rider, RubyMine, and more.
